 Who is Michèle Lamy? 82-year-old fashion icon linked to Jaden Smith in reported viral romance claims: everything you need to know
 SECTIONS Who is Michèle Lamy? 82-year-old fashion icon linked to Jaden Smith in reported viral romance claims: everything you need to know ET Online Last Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 10:01:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Celebrity rumors have surfaced online, claiming a romantic relationship between Jaden Smith and Michèle Lamy. These allegations suggest they may even be engaged, although there is no credible evidence. Michèle Lamy is a prominent fashion figure known for her partnership with designer Rick Owens. Both Jaden Smith and Michèle Lamy have not confirmed the rumors circulating on social media.
 Image courtesy: X An unusual celebrity rumour involving Hollywood actor Jaden Smith and French fashion figure Michèle Lamy has taken social media by surprise. Viral posts have claimed that the 28-year-old actor is romantically involved with the 82-year-old fashion personality, with some even alleging that the pair are engaged. The claims have sparked confusion, jokes and questions about the pictures circulating online. However, there is no credible evidence of a relationship between them, and neither has confirmed the rumours. The story has also brought renewed attention to Lamy, whose distinctive appearance, unconventional career and association with designer Rick Owens have made her a recognised name in the fashion world.
 Who Is Michèle Lamy?
Michèle Lamy is a fashion entrepreneur, artist, performer and creative collaborator. She is best known for her long-standing personal and professional partnership with American fashion designer Rick Owens. Her career has taken several unusual turns. Before entering fashion, Michèle studied law and worked as a criminal defence lawyer in France. She later moved to Los Angeles, where she launched her own clothing line and ran restaurants, including Café des Artistes and Les Deux Cafés.
— justmercy__ (@justmercy__) She hired a young Rick Owens in the 1990s to work on patterns for her fashion business. Their professional relationship eventually developed into a personal partnership. The two married in 2006 and co-founded Owenscorp, building a fashion and design business that includes clothing, furniture and creative projects. In April 2026, Lamy received a Lifetime Achievement Award in Fashion and Culture at the Fashion Trust US Awards . Vanity Fair described her as a fashion iconoclast and highlighted her work across fashion, art and performance. 
 Why Is Michèle Lamy's Appearance Fascinating The Internet?
Michèle Lamy is known for her striking personal style, which includes blackened fingertips, gold teeth, heavy rings and dark makeup. Her unconventional appearance has earned her the nickname "Illuminati Queen" in some online circles. However, the nickname is internet speculation, not evidence of membership in any secret organisation. Her appearance is part of her artistic identity and has been discussed in fashion profiles, including Vogue Adria.
— yk_xiany (@yk_xiany) What Are The Viral Jaden Smith Relationship Claims?
The rumours began circulating on X on November 9 and 10, 2026. Some posts initially claimed that Jaden had visited Michèle to seek her blessings. Others later alleged that they were engaged and that she had promised Jaden 80% of her properties. Several pictures claiming to show the pair together also spread online, with users questioning whether they were AI-generated. A fact-check by IndiaTimes found no evidence of a relationship, engagement, alleged property deal or confirmed home visit.
